title: Improved Friedgut junta size term
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $f$ be a Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$ with values in $\{−1,1\}$, and let $\epsilon,\eta\in\mathbb R$. The improved Friedgut junta size term is $\frac{I(f)^{2+\eta}}{\epsilon^{1+\eta}}\,C(\eta)^k$, where $I(f)$ is the total influence of $f$ and $C(\eta)=\left(\frac{2}{\eta}+1\right)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function $f$ on $\{−1,1\}^n$ with values in $\{−1,1\}$
